errors.text_span: Cardio group showing the lowest negative log-probability value of approximately -26.5 for the baseline model
errors.evidence: In the Cardio group, the baseline light-blue bar reaches about -26.8, not -26.5.

errors.text_span: and values ranging from around -22.5 to -23.5 for the fine-tuned models
errors.evidence: For the Cardio group, the fine-tuned bars are clustered closer to about -25.9 to -26.1, not -22.5 to -23.5. The -22.5 to -23.5 range is more consistent with other groups.

errors.text_span: while the other groups have values generally between -24 and -22
errors.evidence: Several groups include baseline bars near -25 to -27 and fine-tuned bars near -24.5 to -26, so the stated range is too narrow and inaccurate.
